findings.evidence: submit(), lines 16–24, awaits bare fetch and response.json without a timeout or cancellation. Lines 51–53 disable the only submit button while sending; failure guidance appears only after resolution/rejection. The home primary CTA targets this form (home/page.tsx:44). contact/page.tsx:28–29 supplies a separate email fallback, but the pending form never explains when to use it.
findings.userImpact: A stalled connection can leave a prospective client at Sending… with no bounded feedback or in-form recovery. The user cannot tell whether to wait or switch to email, and reloading risks losing the written inquiry. This is a source-derived failure mode, not a reproduced outage.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the request and body-read wait, preserve entered values, and show an actionable unknown-delivery message with an email fallback. Offer retry with clear duplicate-delivery handling. Add a focused intercepted-request test that never resolves and verifies recovery controls become available.
